title: Rolling Sea
line: Every wave is the same wave, arriving.
idea: Starts whole: a two-block ukiyo-e print of five wave bands rolling in parallax under a vermilion sun and a far snow peak, a boat of rowers riding the middle swell.
loop: Each band travels exactly one pattern length; the boat pitches over the swell as the crew pulls.
poster: Inside the loop: the boat on the rise of a swell.
alt: Sketch in woodblock-print style: bands of curling indigo waves with foam beads roll to the right under a red sun and a snow-capped peak, and a boat of rowers rides the swell.

title: Bamboo Wind
line: You only see the wind by what it bends.
idea: Starts whole: a sumi-e grove on rice paper where the wind is the only actor; gusts bend the culms, shiver the leaves and tear a few loose.
loop: Two gusts and the restless breeze between them; leaves tumble across and dry-brush streaks of wind pass.
poster: Inside the loop: the grove leaning into a gust.
alt: Sketch in sumi ink: black and grey bamboo stalks with clusters of brush-stroke leaves bend and sway in gusts of wind on cream rice paper, with a red seal in the corner.

title: Orrery
line: Draw the heavens carefully enough and they start to turn.
idea: Draws on: a blueprint is drafted (compass-swung orbits, column, arms, planets, gear train, dimensions), then the machine accelerates from rest into steady motion.
loop: Planets turn four, three, two and one times, the gears once, twice and three times, with pencil-yellow trails behind the planets.
poster: Inside the loop: the orrery running, trails behind each planet.
alt: Sketch of a blueprint: a planetary orrery drawn in white lines on blue grid paper, with orbit ellipses, a yellow sun, planets on arms, a gear train and dimension lines; the planets and gears turn.

title: Night City
line: Every lit window is somebody still awake.
idea: Starts whole: a three-ink riso poster of a city under a big moon; windows switch on and off, a lit train crosses the elevated line and the river repeats it all upside down.
loop: The train makes one lap, clouds drift one lap, a few windows go dark and come back, the mast light blinks.
poster: Inside the loop: the train crossing in front of the towers.
alt: Sketch in risograph style: a blue and pink city skyline with yellow lit windows under a big yellow moon, a pink train crossing on an elevated line, and the city reflected in the river below.

title: Fiddlehead
line: It was holding all of this, rolled up small.
idea: Grows: on a brushed cyanotype, a fern crozier unrolls into a full frond as a pale photogram shadow, its leaflets opening behind the uncurling tip.
loop: The frond breathes in a draught; a band of sunlight passes over the print with dust turning in it.
poster: Inside the loop: the frond fully open beside a younger crozier.
alt: Sketch of a cyanotype sun print: on a brushed field of Prussian blue, a pale fern fiddlehead unrolls into a tall frond beside grass stems and a small curled crozier.
